name: Slam Royale
desc:
🗿 Welcome to Slam Royale  🗿


Slam your friends in chaotic boulder battles! Swing, launch, and ragdoll your way through the arena in the goofiest, most intense fight of your life.

[How To Play]
• Equip a boulder from the display!
• Run into battle and start swinging!
• Attack players to build up your hit counter!
• Unlock new boulders with unique abilities!

Play with friends, collect wild boulders, and dominate the arena 💥
